meta.title: Deep Dive Career Study — University of Amsterdam research
meta.description: Help us study how AI-assisted self-exploration changes career clarity. ~45 minutes, €15 compensation, fully anonymous.

researchLanding.eyebrow: University of Amsterdam · MSc in AI & Business Analytics
researchLanding.headline: What does your career actually want from you?
researchLanding.subhead: A 45-minute guided self-exploration that doubles as our master's thesis study. You walk away with a personalised career identity report. We walk away with anonymised data to test whether AI changes how people see their work.

study.title: What the study is testing
study.body: Most career-tests sort you into a label. We're testing whether a longer, AI-assisted dive — values, interests, growth direction — actually shifts how clearly you see your own career path one week later. Two conditions are randomly assigned at signup; you'll know which after consent.

whatYouGet.title: What you get
items: A 38-question Quick Dive + 86-question Deep Dive (about 45 min total, can be paused)
A multi-chapter personal career report (LLM-generated, anonymised)
Access to an AI career coach trained on your profile
€15 voucher upon completion of the 7-day follow-up survey

privacy.title: Privacy & ethics
privacy.body: Data is anonymised and stored under GDPR. Only aggregated, de-identified analyses appear in the thesis. You can withdraw at any time and request deletion. Consent is explicit — you'll read the full sheet before any data is recorded.

eligibility.title: Who can join
items: Working or studying in any field (career stage 0–20+ years)
Comfortable reading English or 中文
Has ~45 minutes uninterrupted, plus 10 minutes one week later
